stages.on_b_card_about_a: Janet's daughter, who grows up without her.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Hope helps bring her mother home from the Quantum Realm.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hope's mother, whom she helps bring home.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Janet's daughter, who helps bring her home.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
proposed.text: In the Quantum Realm, Hope confronts her mother for keeping secrets. When Janet tells her about Kang, Hope comforts her and promises they will stop him together.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mother, whose secrets about Kang Hope finally hears.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Daughter, who comforts Janet and vows to stop Kang with her.

their_evidence: Quantumania: Hope repeatedly challenges Janet ('Then make me trust you!'); after Janet tells her about Kang, Hope says 'you are not alone now. We'll stop him together.'

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Hope van Dyne trains Scott Lang to be Ant-Man, and the two fall for each other.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The man Hope trains as Ant-Man, and falls for.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Trainer who makes Scott Ant-Man, and whom he falls for.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: After Scott's trip to Germany costs him her trust, they make up and fight together as Ant-Man and the Wasp.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Partner who lost Hope's trust, now fighting beside her as Ant-Man.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Partner whose trust Scott wins back. They fight as Ant-Man and the Wasp.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Back after five years as dust, Hope reunites with Scott in the battle against Thanos and carries him to the van to start the quantum tunnel. They stand together at Tony Stark's funeral.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Partner, reunited with Hope in the battle against Thanos.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Partner, back from the dust, who carries Scott to the van in battle.

their_evidence: Endgame: Hope arrives through a portal, meets Lang when Rogers tells them to get the tunnel started ('We're on it, Cap'), shrinks and carries Lang to Luis' van; she and Lang attend Stark's funeral with Hank and Janet.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Hope van Dyne trains Scott Lang to be Ant-Man, and the two fall for each other.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Trainer who makes Scott Ant-Man, and whom he falls for.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
proposed.text: In the Quantum Realm, Hope pulls Scott out of a probability storm, then comes back through the portal to save him from Kang. Together they throw Kang into his power core, and they say they love each other.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Partner whom Hope saves twice in the Quantum Realm.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Partner who comes back to save Scott from Kang.

their_evidence: Quantumania: Hope arrives in the power core and helps Scott through the probability storm; she returns through the portal when Kang attacks Scott, and they throw Kang into the core; afterward they exchange 'I love you'.

stages.title: Thor

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Frigga's son.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's mother, the queen of Asgard.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Frigga dies defending Jane Foster when Malekith attacks the palace, leaving Thor to mourn her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Frigga's son, left to mourn her when she dies defending Jane.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's mother, who dies defending Jane from Malekith.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Traveling back in time to Asgard, Thor gets to see his mother one more time, and she reminds him to be who he is.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's mother, met once more, who reminds him to be who he is.

question: Korg's opening recap shows Frigga with baby Thor (new footage) and archive shots of her from earlier films. Is that enough for a stage, or is a recap of earlier events not a new stage?

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Howard Stark is Tony Stark's father, and they are distant while Howard is alive. Through an old film Howard left behind, Tony learns how much his father loved him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Howard's son, distant while Howard lives. Learns how loved he was.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's father, distant in life, whose old recording reveals his love.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Traveling back to 1970, Tony meets his father before he is born and makes peace with him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Howard's son, who meets him in 1970 and makes peace.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's father. Tony meets him in 1970 and makes peace with him.

question: Howard appears in two ways: Tony's BARF simulation of his last night with his parents in 1991 (a recreated real memory, where Tony regrets his last words to his father), and Zemo's footage of Bucky killing Howard, which turns Tony against Steve and Bucky. Does either count as a stage between Howard and Tony, given 'visions and illusions are not events, real flashbacks are'?

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's love, whom he takes to Asgard to save her from the Aether.

their_evidence: Thor finds Foster after the Aether enters her and takes her to Asgard; they reunite in London and Jane's group helps Thor defeat Malekith at the Greenwich Convergence; post-credits they reunite on Earth.

their_evidence: Slingshot episode 3: at the lab Fitz and Simmons upgrade Yo-Yo's watch and do her physical assessment and Inhuman registration together while she secretly runs a search. Minor shared scene; added so the tie shows for a viewer of the web series.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Maggie's fiance, with whom she raises her daughter Cassie.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
proposed.text: Maggie and Paxton, still raising Cassie together, pick her up from Scott's house arrest. When the FBI barges in, Maggie calls it harassment and Paxton tells her the agents are only doing their job.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Maggie's partner, a cop who tells her the FBI is only doing its job.

their_evidence: Paxton and Maggie go to Scott's house together to pick up Cassie, video call him together, return for her soccer shoes when the FBI bursts in (Maggie calls it harassment, Paxton says it isn't), watch Giant-Man on the news together at home, and hug Scott together when his sentence ends. (Fandom says they are married by then, citing a Blu-ray interview, so the text avoids 'married'.)

their_evidence: Muneeba hits a Kree with a vase during the attack on the Khan home; at S.A.B.E.R. she and Yusuf let Kamala go ('You are chosen for a greater purpose... of course you must go now. But I will never let you go'); she hugs Kamala when she returns and helps Carol move in the epilogue.

their_evidence: Yusuf: 'Is Captain Marvel pressuring you in any way?... you don't have to do as she says.' At S.A.B.E.R. Yusuf and Muneeba voice their worry, then let Kamala go; the family hugs her when she returns.

their_evidence: 'The H Word' (Defenders E1): Murdock and Page agree to lunch, then have coffee; he mentions her school board story, they discuss him revealing he is Daredevil and what that life is to him, and she congratulates him on the Aaron James case. Later episodes: E5 he tells her he is Daredevil again and takes her to hide at the precinct; E7 she warns him his identity could be exposed; E8 she grieves when he does not return from Midland Circle (see owner call).

question: The proposed Defenders stage sits at #1 (coffee). Should there also be a stage at The Defenders#8, where Karen grieves when Matt does not come back from Midland Circle? (S3#6 already says she refuses to believe he died.)

Season 6 has no stage before the proposed #123: Fitz, captured by Malachi, is reunited with Simmons on the Confederacy ship, they are plugged into the Cerebral Fusion Machine, then fly home together. Add a reunion stage mid-S6 (outside this batch's titles)?
